[SWS_PHM_00225]
⌈
If
the
Global Supervision Status
was
GLOBAL_STATUS_OK, the Local Supervision Status of at least one Super-
vised Entity Instance is LOCAL_STATUS_EXPIRED and the expiredSupervi-
sionTolerance is configured to zero, then the Platform Health Management
shall change the Global Supervision Status to GLOBAL_STATUS_STOPPED.
⌋

[SWS_PHM_00225] Switch Global Supervision Status from kOK to kSTOPPED
⌈
If the Global Supervision Status is kOK, the Elementary Su-
pervision Status of at least one Alive, Deadline or Logical Supervision is
kEXPIRED, the expiredSupervisionTolerance is configured to zero and the
GlobalSupervision corresponds to Operating System, Execution Management
or State Management, then the Platform Health Management shall change
the Global Supervision Status to kSTOPPED.
⌋
